items.title: You choose
items.text: Pick your equipment from the catalogue, or simply describe your event.

items.title: We send a quote
items.text: With availability, delivery and set-up included, no surprises.

items.title: We deliver, set up and clear away
items.text: On the day, everything is in place. The next day, we pack up.

reviews.title: They trusted us with their reception
reviews.intro: Our clients' feedback is shared in the "Vos retours" highlight on Instagram.

items.a: A security deposit may be requested depending on the items hired. The amount and terms are shown on your quote.
When we set up, we also take down and collect everything ourselves. For collection orders, the return day and time are agreed when you book.
Yes, anywhere in Normandy. Delivery costs depend on distance and volume and are shown on the quote.

items.q: How far ahead should I book?
items.a: As early as possible for wedding weekends, especially from May to September. For a small hire, a few days is often enough: message us to check availability.

items.q: Do I need to wash the tableware before returning it?
items.a: No. Cleaning costs €5 if the tableware comes back clean and €8 if it comes back dirty.
Yes, our catering is halal and alcohol-free.
